answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The forge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ivory. By the wander of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
